a: Outline-glyph meshes bake the text's position into float32 vertices with no `origin`, so outlined text far from the origin jitters
`meshGradientXml` joins corner colors with spaces, so a mesh with any functional-notation color does not survive an SVG round trip
The mesh bake hands straight-alpha texels to a texture the paint-kind contract says is premultiplied, so bilinear sampling darkens every mesh edge
`blendFactorsOf` looks a composite name up on a plain object, so an unknown name throws a bare TypeError and `'constructor'` resolves to a function
`meshFromStops` leaves the span before the first stop and after the last uncovered, so a gradient whose stops don't sit at 0 and 1 loses its ends on conversion
`renderIdsAsync` throws synchronously instead of rejecting when the id frame fails
b: meshGradientXml writes patch colors space-joined, so any CSS color containing a space does not round-trip
A mesh patch color that does not parse throws out of the render
meshFromStops drops the pad regions outside the first and last stop, and a single stop at offset 1 yields an empty mesh
Mesh bake is straight alpha but sampled bilinear, so every patch edge inside the bake box gets a dark fringe
A vector image's first raster is made at its declared size with no cap
A blurred drop shadow's interior is ~70% of its color where an unblurred one is 100%
Composite operator names are looked up on a plain object, so an unknown or inherited name throws or reads Object.prototype
imageStatus counts as an image read for a minted bitmap name but not for any other src
